title: Abandoned Roblox Mall
one_sentence: A compact low-poly mall atrium prepared for Roblox-style exploration.
source_prompt: An abandoned Roblox-ready low-poly mall atrium with shuttered storefronts, a dry fountain planter, a broken escalator, and one glowing security gate hinting at a hidden arcade.

intent.setting: A deserted mall atrium built from chunky modular props and readable silhouettes.
intent.emotional_goal: The scene should feel inviting to inspect while still clearly abandoned.
intent.primary_interaction: Inspect the glowing security gate and decide whether to reveal the hidden arcade.
intent.spatial_logic: A central fountain anchors the grid, with storefronts and a broken escalator framing a simple player path.

style.lighting: Soft skylight with a small warm glow at the security gate.

required_elements.description: A row of closed storefront arches.
A central dry fountain planter used as the focal point.
A blocked escalator that marks the far side of the atrium.
A glowing security gate that hints at an arcade behind it.

camera_intents.purpose: Show the whole playable atrium and the central fountain.
Inspect the glowing gate and hidden arcade clue.

curiosity_goals: Why is the security gate still glowing?
What is behind the shuttered arcade?
Who left the fountain planter arranged like a waypoint?
authoring_notes: Phase 24 Roblox export-lane example. The manifest is a contract artifact only; Studio import remains downstream.
